named_premises: A Self-Other boundary requires informational distinction (some information not shared or observed).
Total transparency means there is no informational distinction.
If the Self-Other boundary is absent, the AI self-model collapses.
Opacity is represented as the absence of total transparency.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: Opacity is necessary for the Self-Other boundary; total transparency collapses informational distinction and thereby the boundary and AI self-model.

obstructions.scope: domain application rather than mere notation
obstructions.reason: Terminal-observer opacity is an adopted epistemic boundary condition, not a derived formal result.
